description: Retrieve a member profile, roles, committee seats, official contact information, registered interests or recorded voting history. Roles without category lists available biography categories; select category to page whole periods. Interests and voting require an explicit House. Committee person IDs differ from member IDs. Voting uses native 20-row pages and reports recorded lobby and teller facts, without lifetime participation metrics. Follow collection cursors with unchanged selectors; use contentCursor to reconstruct oversized records.
